quest.title: Currents Deep Beneath the Lanterns
quest.description: The highlight of Lantern Rite is the release of the giant Mingxiao Lantern into the sky, and this year's Mingxiao Lantern is supposed to be a sight well worth the wait. The Plaustrite that will lift the lantern into the air is the largest in twenty years! For this special occasion, the merchants of Liyue have set up the Xiao Market to help gather the materials needed to build the lantern. When you arrive at the Xiao Market, one of the event organizers, Wang'ya, seems to have something to say to you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x60, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello again, Wang'ya! How's the Mingxiao Lantern construction coming along?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Good to see you two! The Mingxiao Lantern is coming along smoothly, thank you. We're almost done collecting the required Plaustrite.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: The project should be completed in a few days... You'll have to come by when it's done!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Plaustrite?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm, plaustrite is the main component of any Mingxiao Lantern. Most of the donations we get from the city folk are either Mora or Plaustrite.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: A lot of them carve their heart's desires onto the Plaustrite they donate, as a prayer for good fortune and other blessings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon wants some good fortune too! Let's find some Plaustrite and make a wish, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Hm, since you seem so eager to donate, how about you keep your eyes open for less common varieties of Plaustrite? Those are the ones we lack the most at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: One is called <color=#00E1FFFF>Azurite</color>. It is occasionally found in the northern part of Mt. Tianheng.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: When Azurite gets caught in the roots of ordinary vegetation, it sometimes produces <color=#00E1FFFF>Bloatty Floatties</color>, which have floating seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: The other one is called <color=#00E1FFFF>Vermillionite</color>, which is extremely dangerous as far as most people are concerned...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: In Guili Plains, old <color=#00E1FFFF>Ruin Hunters</color> who have lost the power of flight use <color=#00E1FFFF>Vermillionite</color> to keep themselves airborne.

choices.text: We'll head out to look for those then.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: It's a tall order, but I'm sure you can manage.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Well... they're just more stylish, I suppose.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: (Actually, they're just blue and red varieties of Plaustrite... Gemstone merchants only gave them fancy names to try and impress their customers...)

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Uh, the difference in their features compared to regular Plaustrite might be minuscule... but the difference in price is astonishing.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: No, no, never mind that. Just bring some <color=#00E1FFFF>Azurite</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>Vermillionite</color> back to me. I'm counting on you!

talks.objective: Obtain Vermillionite from the Ruin Hunter
Dig at the roots of the Bloatty Floatty

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wang'ya, we're back with a fresh supply of Azurite and Vermillionite!

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: I knew I could count on you! Let me see... Hmm... Yep! Without a doubt, these are Azurite and Vermillionite.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: But don't you want to make your wishes? You brought back just enough materials for both of you. Come on, get carving!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Done! Paimon prays for a bottomless stomach to eat more delicacies with!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And you? Let Paimon see... Huh? Well, that doesn't sound like something you'd wish for...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #So you made a wish for {M#her}{F#him} instead...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't you worry, Paimon will help you find {M#her}{F#him}, and we'll spend the next Lantern Rite together.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then, we'll release a gazillion Xiao Lanterns to make up for all those wishes you've never had a chance to make!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We sure will.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: If you're done with your carvings, you can hand over your Azurite and Vermillionite to me.

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Ms. Wang'ya...

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Well hello, Changchang! What's up, little missy? Can't find your granddad?

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Granddad said he's busy and I should go play on my own.

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: I wanna make a Xiao Lantern, but I don't know how...

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Ms. Wang'ya, could you help me make a Xiao Lantern?

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Sure thing! But promise me that you'll go back home as soon as we're done playing. With so many people at the festival, your granddad will be worried sick if you stay out too long.

response.speaker: Changchang
response.text: Hehe. Thank you, Ms. Wang'ya! I'll be a good girl, I promise!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, you know how to make Xiao Lanterns too?

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: I certainly do! That's how I made my first Mora, helping visitors make Xiao Lanterns by the docks. Ah... Good times, hehe!

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: I should really stay here to keep an eye on the girl — hey, could I bother you to go to the <color=#00E1FFFF>construction site</color> at <color=#00E1FFFF>the dock</color>, and gather some building materials?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Happy to help.

response.speaker: Wang'ya
response.text: Great, thanks. I appreciate it.

choices.text: #I really hope {M#her}{F#his} wish will come true.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh... so you put your {M#sister}{F#brother}'s wish rather than your own...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Wh—Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jiayi sent us.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Oh... Thank you. If it weren't for your help, today may have ended quite differently.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it you're doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: I'm in charge of keeping the Lantern Rite safe. A lot comes out of the woodwork at this time of year, there are thieves around every corner.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: I encountered one during my patrol just now, so I called a few men and we pursued them out here.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Once we got here we decided to split up. I was searching this area.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: The thief seems to have made a clean getaway, and I sure didn't bank on these monsters being here...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: I was just assessing whether it would be better to send for reinforcements, or find another way to disperse them... And that's when you showed up and dealt with them.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: *sigh* And thank goodness. I don't know how long it would've taken for the others to get here.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Well, I need to get back to looking for that thief... But thanks for your help. Until next time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! We're not done here!

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Oh? Is there something else?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's a suspicious character down at the harbor...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Ugh, another one? *sigh* It's interminable...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Right. When I get back, I'll get the other troops to be extra vigilant in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: *sigh* In the middle of the festival too. What are they up to...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The locals must take all their tasty treats for granted by now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But for a poor traveler, all alone out in the wilderness, often forced to survive on nothing but the most mysterious of mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For you, the Lantern Rite is the most important of all festivals!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So let's go back to the place where we <color=#00E1FFFF>witnessed the shady-looking guy</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon hears from patrol officers that criminals love to go back for another look at the crime scene after the event. Eh, it's a psychological thing, apparently.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But the crime hasn't even happened yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's why there's no time to lose! When there's highly flammable materials involved, once the crime happens it'll be too late!

talks.objective: Go to the construction site and collect the materials

dialogues.text: Hey, whatcha doin'?
Whatcha staring at me like that for? Get gone!
Wha— Huh?
...Alright, if you all won't get gone, I'm just gonna get going myself I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow. Paimon thought he might be a shady character, then he opened his mouth and now Paimon's sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He must have been up to something when he was crouching down on the ground. Because as soon as he saw us approaching, he stood up and acted all innocent...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon has a bad feeling about this...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What could he be up to? Let's investigate!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: On the last day of the Lantern Rite, huge crowds come out to watch the Mingxiao Lantern being released.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It can't be a good sign if there's a suspicious character lurking around somewhere so dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If he's been tampering with the stockpile of lantern supplies...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's get the materials we came for first. We can tell Wang'ya about the situation when we get back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, you're taking this very seriously. Why?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Because... Because... Everyone in Liyue has worked really hard for this! No one should be allowed to spoil it, period!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What's the real reason?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, fine... There's so many delicacies in Liyue Harbor! Matsutake Meat Rolls, Mora Meat, Almond Tofu...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you reading those off a menu?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Did you get the materials?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! These will do. Let me make a Xiao Lantern for Changchang.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's more...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We saw a shady character skulking around the highly flammable materials at the construction site!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He looked like he was up to no good...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: I see... Okay, please inform the <color=#00E1FFFF>Ministry of Civil Affairs</color> about what you saw. I'll talk to Jingming.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: With so many people visiting for the Lantern Rite, we can't afford to ignore something like this.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Ms. Wang'ya, is something bad gonna happen at the Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Not to a darling little angel like you, Changchang! Come on now, good girl, head back to your granddad and don't get distracted along the way. We don't want to make him worry.

talks.objective: Go to the Ministry of Civil Affairs and report to the Millelith

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Halt! This is the Liyue Ministry of Civil Affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We are here to report a suspicious individual.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we saw a shady-looking guy snooping around near the stockpile of highly flammable Mingxiao Lantern supplies!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We must defend the Grilled Tiger Fish food stall at all costs!

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Hmm, goodness! This is a serious matter indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly what Paimon thought! Liyue Harbor's cuisine is the heart and soul of the city—

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...It seems we disagree on where the seriousness of the matter lies. But you're not wrong, my little friend.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Rest easy, the Ministry of Civil Affairs has assigned a specialist to keep the Lantern Rite safe.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I will inform him of this matter and order him to step up vigilance in due course.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "In due course"? This is serious, why not get your butt over there and tell him straight away?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I wish I could, but he's yet to return. He's taken a small team to <color=#00E1FFFF>Guili Plains</color>.

choices.text: I'll go to Guili Plains and tell them.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Huh? Uh... But you're a traveler, aren't you? You've come all this way for the Lantern Rite, and yet you are willing to lend a hand...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Our pleasure! We're experts in this kinda stuff. We lend hands all the time, like the time we—

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ahem, leave it to us.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: R—Really? Then we are indebted to you. Travelers are so kind these days...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Ah yes, no commission should go unpaid...

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: I will take care of the compensation. Again, thank you both.

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: What commission...? Oh, is this your way of offering to go to <color=#00E1FFFF>Guili Plains</color> and pass on the message for me?

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: But you're a traveler, aren't you? You've come all this way for the Lantern Rite, and yet here you are willing to lend a hand...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The food stalls must be protected!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We must defend the food stalls! Let nobody touch them!

response.speaker: Jiayi
response.text: Uh — absolutely! Haha... I can't thank you enough.

talks.objective: Go back to the crime scene

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! Knew it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, there's another person—

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Xiao... Are you here for the festival?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I have no interest in Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: #Well, well, long time no see, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kaeya, we went to the Lantern Rite in Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah. Well, how was it? Fun?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well then, you ought to be looking forward to Mondstadt's Ludi Harpastum. I'm sure it will be to your liking.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Get to the point, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right, right! Kaeya, there's something we need to tell you about.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Lantern supplies... Stockpile of wood, paper, and oil... At the very least, it sounds like an accident waiting to happen.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Haha, how very amusing. What makes you think I would recognize this symbol?

choices.text: You're amazing at everything and we trust you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, that about sums it up!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hah. I'm flattered, but don't you think you might be overestimating me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There it is! At last, Kaeya displays the knightly virtue of modesty, perfectly articulated and masterfully delivered.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: My goodness, your stay in Liyue seems to have sharpened your wit and broadened your vocabulary.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Anyway, I digress. This is the symbol of the cross-border criminal organization you know as the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: If you are curious to know more, I can put you in touch with an informant on the inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, didn't you just say the Knights of Favonius don't have dealings with their enemies!?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: ...This is my own personal informant. Nothing to do with the Knights of Favonius.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: A little later, make your way over to Windrise. I'll arrange for the informant to meet you there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Kaeya.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, and remember: "wine begets wisdom."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

choices.text: You flirt with the dark side, so you would know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Uh-ah! You should watch what you say, Honorary Knight.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: What do you mean, flirt with the dark side? The Knights of Favonius certainly does not have dealings with its enemies.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: That has to do with a certain knightly virtue called "integrity."

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! You're the guy, right? Kaeya's informant?

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: Informant? Not me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But... This is the place we agreed upon... and you're the only other one here, so...

dialogues.speaker: Nimrod
dialogues.text: "Place we agreed upon"? Heh, I know nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, stop being so annoying!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay. Yeah, it's me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was any of that even slightly necessary!?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: What do you want to know about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Here's the situation...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay. I see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So? What can you tell us as an insider?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: I do not think this is the work of the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: The reason the Treasure Hoarders are able to sustain a giant cross-border operation is because they abide by one fundamental principle:

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Caution. Softly softly catchee monkey is the name of the game for them. By contrast, the idea of taking huge risks to try and make a fortune is utter folly in their eyes.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Liyue has the adepti looking after it, doesn't it? And they're especially active during the Lantern Rite...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: There's just no way that we... sorry, "they"! Slip of the tongue — when you've been undercover as long as I have, heh, where was I... Oh, yes — There's just no way that they — the Treasure Hoarders — would dare make a move during the Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Also... the Treasure Hoarders' organization in Liyue recently received an anonymous letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why would someone send them an anonymous letter? Trying to frame them, perhaps?

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Nobody knows. But what I can tell you is which branch of the Treasure Hoarders has the letter in their possession.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: ...There. I've marked their location on the map for you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Great. Well, Paimon thinks this was productive! {NICKNAME}, this is our only solid lead. Let's not waste it!

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: If there's nothing more, I should get back to treasure hoarding. ...I mean, get back to those treasure-hoarding lowlifes. To spy on them. Heh.

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Uh...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Okay... technically the wrong password, but... yes, it's something about wine, and assuming that something is the thing about it begetting wisdom, then...

response.speaker: Nimrod
response.text: Yeah, close enough. It's me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How was any of that even slightly necessary!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh! Did you just appear out of thin air!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's an adeptus for you...

talks.objective: Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see what they wrote.

talks.objective: Talk to the member of the Treasure Hoarders
Meet the sender at the meeting spot

dialogues.text: Alright, you folks from the Treasure Hoarders, yeah? I thought I insinuated in my letter there that you should have done like I done and put on a mask and a costume and so forth...
...But it seems you didn't all get the memo. Hehehe... it's pretty cool though... gutsy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Well guess what? We don't need to go sneaking around everywhere wearing disguises! Because unlike you, we would never do anything so shameful that we would need to wear masks while doing it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really!? I was in the middle of my speech and everything!

choices.text: I think he just enjoys dressing up...

response.text: Wait a second now... You folks ain't no Treasure Hoarders! What game are you two playing!?

choices.text: This get up is pretty cool, though...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now that the Millelith have gotten hold of that idiot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head back. We can notify the <color=#00E1FFFF>Ministry of Civil Affairs</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Traveler, word spreads fast! We will keep watch over the thief, thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Looks like the Mingxiao Lantern will be ready soon. A critical juncture, we cannot afford the slightest interference.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On the topic of keeping Lantern Rite safe...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Rest easy, word was passed up the chain. Another group of very capable troops has been brought in.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: They're dressed as ordinary citizens, you wouldn't notice them in the crowd. If anyone dares make a move, they'll be on them in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: That's sorted then. You two get some rest, we'll take it from here. Enjoy Lantern Rite in peace!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Paimon supposes that's taken care of, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If only Xiao were here to see the Mingxiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Paimon wishes so too. Guess he won't make it this time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, do you remember what the inspiration for the Mingxiao Lantern was?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, with a name like... Skybracer, or something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So if it's modeled on an adeptus, maybe Xiao would be interested this time?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: On the day the Mingxiao Lantern is ready, we can meet him at <color=#00E1FFFF>Wangshu Inn</color> like he suggested, then try to persuade him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though he said you can see the Mingxiao Lantern from Wangshu Inn... We should get up close if we wanna get that festival atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I sensed a malign influence here. I'm here to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: When a shackle is loosened in the realms of deities and demons, I take full responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world — your world. Thus you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: When the time comes, I hope you shall act promptly and decisively...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I do not wish for the tassel of the polearm that has slaughtered countless demons to become stained with mortal blood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: A symbol that your suspected evildoer left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Paimon, do you recognize it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't look familiar to Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Well, you will have to show me how much you can accomplish on your own strength.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Because if I become involved, there is a possibility that the streets of Liyue Harbor will be painted red this Lantern Rite.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, quite a festive color in this part of the world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds terrible!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, let's not be impulsive. Why don't we figure out the origins of this symbol first?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, let's not be impulsive. Why don't we figure out the origins of this symbol first?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then it's up to me to avoid that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The one the suspected criminal left behind... Oh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a sneaking suspicion that Kaeya will know something about it...

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Please, oh great one! Heroic Yaksha of Liyue! Divine Adeptus and friend of the people! Have mercy!

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: The letter is drivel anyway! It's not worth an armed conflict... Just take it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about that — Paimon knew it all along!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: I see. Then let us send these two to the meeting.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: The sender may be plotting something truly diabolical for the Lantern Rite. It seems they want to burn down the entire city.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Great, everyone's happy. You're good, we're good. However...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: These two... They don't look anything like us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'll be fine. When we're in disguise, no-one will be the wiser.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: It still seems like a long shot to me, but... with the help of an adeptus, hopefully everything will turn out fine...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Well, the safety of Liyue is in your hands now. Good luck — even the Treasure Hoarders don't want to see the city burned to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Then it is settled.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: *sigh* What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Next time we meet...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's make it somewhere with a view of the Mingxiao Lantern.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...I am not partial to crowded areas. Especially at this time of the year.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: ...Understood. I shall await your news there.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Sorry mate, wrong way. Wherever you think you're going, it's that way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But isn't that the way to Liyue Harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Right. Here is nowhere. So the other way is Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: If you're looking for somewhere to stay, I suggest you go to the Wangshu Inn. Fair prices, great customer service, and a wonderful view.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show us the anonymous letter.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: ...How do you know about the letter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uh, one of Liyue's adepti told us about it!

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Did they now? I somehow doubt that.
You should not doubt it. It was I who sent them to investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Any further questioning, you may direct to me.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: ...You're the Vigilant Yaksha!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, watch your tone of voice! Or do you seriously wanna pick a fight with an adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Uh, okay. It's not that we don't believe you're an adeptus, it's just... Everyone needs to look at the bigger picture here.

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: As you well know, we Treasure Hoarders are no serious threat to anyone. We're petty criminals, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: So if you are truly an adeptus, please... Show us some mercy, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Bei'er
dialogues.text: Of course, if it turns out you're not a real adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Crafty
dialogues.text: Then please, don't blame our weapons for treating everyone equally...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tell us your diabolical plan, now! It's over, buster!
Okay! I give up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Give up now or feel the wrath of my Paimonial... Huh? You're giving up just like that?
I, uh... I'm just a lowly apprentice thief who really looks up to the Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An apprentice thief!?
Yeah... For a greenhorn like me, 'specially working on my own an' all... The Treasure Hoarders? Man, they're my heroes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second, so—
...So, I thought I'd try and set up some sorta lucrative opportunity, then submit my pledge of loyalty...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! None of this is making any sense!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was expecting a serial arsonist to be someone more... sinister! Evil-looking! But instead... We get you!?
...Arson? What the heck are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't pretend! Paimon's seen you, loitering around piles of highly flammable materials!
Oh... Oh yeah, yeah, I know where you're talkin' about. But I was only checking the place out.
My plan ain't got nothing to do with those lantern construction materials.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Are you serious!?
I just wanted to nab me the biggest chunk of Plaustrite in twenty years is all...
I was gonna wait till nightfall, chop off half the tethers, float it out to sea...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...
Then all I'd have to do is find some way or another of bringing it down, so I could hide it underwater in the shallows. The perfect crime!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, for a perfect crime, it sure has a lot of holes... For example, how exactly were you planning to bring down the Plaustrite once it was airborne?
I was still in the process of figuring out the details, hence why I hadn't made my move yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This guy is an imbecile!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Okay, {NICKNAME}, let's teach him a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Azurite</color> is occasionally found in the northern part of Mt. Tianheng.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: It is said that when Azurite gets caught in the roots of ordinary vegetation, it sometimes produces <color=#00E1FFFF>Bloatty Floatties</color>, which have floating seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Perhaps you can start by tracking down <color=#00E1FFFF>Bloatty Floatties</color>. They might lead you to <color=#00E1FFFF>Azurite</color> deposits.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: And then you can check out Guili Plains, where old <color=#00E1FFFF>Ruin Hunters</color> who have lost the power of flight use <color=#00E1FFFF>Vermillionite</color> to keep themselves airborne.

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: Don't go looking for Ruin Hunters unprepared, though. They can be quite deadly.

dialogues.speaker: Changchang
dialogues.text: Why does it have to be so hard? I'll never learn how to make a Xiao Lantern...

dialogues.speaker: Wang'ya
dialogues.text: All in good time. Don't give up, practice makes perfect.
